ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT BYANDBETWEEN 2966-2968 JEROME AVE., LLC AND 2-14BEDFORDPARKBLVD.,LLC BRONX COUNTY BLOCK 3320 LOTS 8 AND 9 DATED:December_3,2025 RECORD ANDRETURNTO: Sheldon Lobel, P.C. Attn:Richard Lobel, Esq. 122East 42nd Street,Suite 2305 New York, NY 10168

ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the _3rd _day of December_, 2025, by and between 2966-2968 JEROME AVE., LLC ("Owner"), and 2-14 BEDFORD PARK BLVD., LLC ("Developer"), both New York limited liability companies, having an address at 1 New King Street, Suite 201, West Harrison,NY 10604(Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter each referred to as a "Party"or collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,locatedin theBoroughof Bronx,CountyofBronx,City andStateofNew York, known as and by the street address 2966-2968 Jerome Avenue, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof and known as Tax Block 3320, Lot 8 (the “Owner Land"; said buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon together with any alterations thereto or future replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner infee of certain land located in theBorough of Bronx and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof and known as Tax Block 3320, Tax Lot 9 (together, the“Developer Land"); WHEREAS,Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Developer Land (said buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon together with any alterations thereto or future replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement,being herein collectively called the "Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Parcel"), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the “Retained Development Rights” (as hereinafter defined) and that are availablefor transfer in accordance with the ZoningResolution (the“Excess Development Rights"); WHEREAS,Owner and Developer intend tomake theExcessDevelopment Rights available for utilization in connection with the construction of the Developer Building; 2
